Crystalmere, a translucent elven city of hollow towers refracting sunlight into soft cascading rainbows, built upon a still mirror-lake that doubles its impossible glowing beauty into the depths below.
Lunassiel, a moonlit haven of pearl-white glowing domes rising from a silver meadow, their curved surfaces drinking the full moon's radiance and breathing it back as a soft unearthly luminescence.

Vethrandor, a cliffside city of cascading pale terraces descending the sheer face of a great coastal bluff, flowering balconies overflowing with white blooms, the whole grand face mirrored in the sea below.

Elaryndel, a city grown entire within one colossal living tree, its vast hollow chambers lit by bioluminescent moss, spiraling interior staircases carved into breathing heartwood, roots arching below into a clear singing river.

Silvarath, a lakeside city of soaring arching bridges connecting ivory islets across still amber water, slender towers rising from each island, firefly lanterns drifting on the warm evening air between the graceful spans.

Auranthas, a city canopied beneath an endless cathedral of golden autumn leaves, its copper-roofed halls and winding amber avenues perpetually bathed in warm honeyed light filtering through the ancient rustling boughs above.

Misthollow, a mountain-vale city of pale halls half-dissolved in perpetual silver mist, its delicate spires emerging above the cloud like quiet thoughts, terraced gardens scenting the cool air with white flowering herbs.

Virendael, a city of slender flowering towers entirely wrapped in cascading living vines, violet and ivory blossoms opening at dawn, the whole city breathing with color and fragrance, its walls alive with slow green growth.
